question: By how much could direct recycling reduce greenhouse gas and SOx emissions from cathode material production, according to Dunn et al.?
rendered: According to the document, Dunn et al. estimated that the direct recycling process has the potential to reduce greenhouse gas and SOx emissions from cathode material production by 81–98% and 72% to nearly 100%, respectively.
